title: Repeated multipart parsing races with form readers
claim: After initial multipart parsing, the woven repeated ParseMultipartForm call writes already-managed strings into Request.Form and Request.PostForm slices while application goroutines may read the populated forms; an uninstrumented repeated call does not write these slices.
repro_command: cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/life-lazy-reader && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -race -timeout 10m -count=1 -run 'TestReview(RepeatedMultipartParseDoesNotWriteForm|MultiReaderDoesNotTaintCleanPrefix)$' -v ./iast/net/http ./iast/io

title: Mixed MultiReader marks trusted bytes as request body
claim: Binding a composite io.MultiReader when only one component reader is HTTP-bound leads ReadAllBytes to mark the whole output, including clean bytes from unbound components, as an HTTP request-body source.
repro_command: cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/life-lazy-reader && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -race -timeout 10m -count=1 -run 'TestReview(RepeatedMultipartParseDoesNotWriteForm|MultiReaderDoesNotTaintCleanPrefix)$' -v ./iast/net/http ./iast/io
